plan.title: fix(umbrella-current-shape): report a reason on the selected-null path at the three silent cache-side callers

narratives.Description: On a contributor-only thread the sidecar builder, appendCurrentShapeSection, and ingest's CurrentShape omission return a bare null, so a cache-reading agent that never invokes the CLI falls back to the stale issue body. Add an advisory reason on that null path only.
narratives.Overview:
## What the design-critique arc bound, and what it struck

The issue as filed did not survive its arc. The accepted lean is comment 5466514662; the verified-claims table is 5466514758; the synthesis is 5466516467. An implementer reads those, not the body.

**Struck, and deliberately not built here:**

- "Nothing reports the discard" is false. `NON_MAINTAINER_CURRENT_SHAPE_MESSAGE` already ships at `packages/core/src/umbrella-current-shape/index.ts:478`, and `fetchCurrentShape` branches on `hadNonMaintainerShape` at 499-506. On a contributor-only thread `deft umbrella:current-shape` already exits 1 naming that exact situation. No new CLI diagnostic is built.
- Two filed acceptance criteria are a forge-to-fail vector. Anyone who can comment can post a `## Current shape (as of pass-N)` line. Making the `!= 1` count include discarded candidates, or making `--strict` exit non-zero when one exists, would let any commenter fail the health gates on every tracker that already has a valid maintainer shape. That inverts #2307 from "ignore forgeries" to "forgeries break the gate". Both criteria are struck.
- The filed consumer inventory was wrong: `selectIngestCurrentShapeComment` does not exist (the wrapper is `selectIngestCurrentShape`), `countIngestCurrentShapeComments` has no call sites, and ingest Overview concatenates the whole thread rather than taking a silent null branch.

**Trust filter stays.** `MAINTAINER_ASSOCIATIONS` remains `{OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR}`.

## What is built

One shared, advisory `describeCurrentShapeNull` primitive in `umbrella-current-shape`, classifying the selected-null path as `no-shape-comment` or `non-maintainer-shape` and naming discarded candidates by comment id plus a normalized `author_association`. Wired at the three silent cache-side callers:

1. the sidecar builder returns `{ sidecar, reason }` instead of a bare null;
2. `appendCurrentShapeSection` appends a short `## Canonical current shape: not selected` note to cache `content.md`;
3. `buildIssueVbrief` sets `narratives.CurrentShapeUnavailable`.

## Constraints held

- Advisory only. Nothing new fails closed; no exit code, gate, or required check changes (#3156).
- Selected-null path only. When a maintainer shape is selected, the emitted artifacts are byte-identical to today, including on a mixed thread that also carries a discarded contributor draft.
- Callers stay silent on the plain `no-shape-comment` case so ordinary non-umbrella issues gain no new noise.
- Diagnostics never reproduce a comment body. They carry the numeric comment id and an author association normalized to `[A-Z_]` or `UNKNOWN`.
- `--strict` and the maintainer count are untouched.

## Left to the operator, deliberately not acted on

The arc found `blocks-release-tag` disproportionate to the measured blast radius; the label is the operator's to change and stays. The title's "no reader-visible shape" claim is scoped down to the contributor-only case on the thread; the issue is not re-cut.

Refs #3934, #2307, #1152, #1870, #2143, #3156.
